      "snippet": "Short answer: no — not in the way people usually mean “learned.”
Long answer below, stated precisely and without hedging.

1. What “learning” would mean in a strict sense
Learning would require at least one of the following to persist without re-supplying artifacts:

New internal memory

Changed behavior in a future, fresh chat

Automatic enforcement of rules you did not restate or rehydrate

None of those con
